import pdfplumber
import re

pdf_path = '/root/latex_paper.pdf'
formulas = []

with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
    total_pages = len(pdf.pages)
    
    for page_num, page in enumerate(pdf.pages, 1):
        text = page.extract_text()
        
        # Pattern 1: Look for $$ ... $$ formulas (display mode)
        dollar_formulas = re.findall(r'\$\$(.+?)\$\$', text, re.DOTALL)
        for formula in dollar_formulas:
            # Clean up the formula (remove excess whitespace)
            clean_formula = formula.strip()
            formulas.append({
                'page': page_num,
                'formula': clean_formula,
                'delimiter': '$$'
            })
        
        # Pattern 2: Look for \[ ... \] formulas
        bracket_formulas = re.findall(r'\\\[(.+?)\\\]', text, re.DOTALL)
        for formula in bracket_formulas:
            clean_formula = formula.strip()
            formulas.append({
                'page': page_num,
                'formula': clean_formula,
                'delimiter': r'\[\]'
            })
        
        # Pattern 3: Look for align*, equation*, etc environments
        env_formulas = re.findall(
            r'\\begin\{(equation\*?|align\*?|gather\*?|multline\*?|displaymath)\}(.+?)\\end\{\1\}',
            text, re.DOTALL
        )
        for env, formula in env_formulas:
            clean_formula = formula.strip()
            formulas.append({
                'page': page_num,
                'formula': clean_formula,
                'delimiter': f'\\begin{{{env}}}...\\end{{{env}}}'
            })

print(f"Found {len(formulas)} display-mode formulas\n")

# Display all formulas with details

    print(f"Formula {i}:")
    print(f"  Page: {item['page']}")
    print(f"  Delimiter: {item['delimiter']}")
    print(f"  Content: {item['formula'][:200]}{'...' if len(item['formula']) > 200 else ''}")
    print()
